summary.text: Keturah Herron is a Democratic member of the Kentucky Senate representing District 35, with House service from 2022 to 2024 and Senate service since 2025.

paragraphs.text: According to the legislature's profile, Keturah J. Herron was born on March 22, 1980.
The profile lists a B.A. in sports administration from the University of Louisville and an M.A. in corrections and juvenile justice studies from Eastern Kentucky University.
It also lists the Tammy Baldwin Breakthrough Award from the Victory Institute (2024) and recognition as one of USA Today's Women of the Year (2022).
